print("GC content min/max/mean:", min(g for _,g in gc), max(g for _,g in gc), sum(g for _,g in gc)/len(gc))

# Direct repeats - find repeated substrings length>=20
from collections import defaultdict
for L in (50,40,30,20):
    d=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(len(seq)-L+1):
        d[seq[i:i+L]].append(i+1)
    reps=[(k,v) for k,v in d.items() if len(v)>1]
    print("L=",L,"num repeated substrings:", len(reps))
